answer_1.quote: Automatic chart summarization is a task where the goal is to explain a chart and summarize key takeaways from it in natural language... We present a large-scale benchmark for chart-to-text with two datasets consisting of 44,096 charts...
answer_1.outputs: Natural language summaries describing the insights and key points of a chart

answer_2.quote: For automatic evaluation of the summary quality, we utilized five measures. BLEU and CIDEr measure n-gram overlaps... BLEURT ... Content Selection (CS) metric ... Perplexity (PPL) using a pre-trained GPT-2 Medium.

answer_4.quote: We performed a human evaluation on 150 randomly sampled charts from the Statista dataset with four internal annotators who are native speakers of English. For each chart, annotators performed pairwise comparisons ... They compared the summaries based on three criteria: (i) Factual correctness ... (ii) Coherence ... and (iii) Fluency.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators compared generated summaries pairwise against gold summaries, judging which was better or if they were tied, based on factual correctness, coherence, and fluency.
